title: Inguinal hernia (adult)
seen_note: 442F — as previous exams" (inguinal hernia); 435F — listed only ("scrotal swelling — inguinal hernia")
scenario: You are given the examination findings of a 45-year-old man with a right groin swelling: above and medial to the pubic tubercle; cough impulse present; reduces spontaneously on lying down; above the inguinal ligament; cannot get above it; no bowel sounds over it; non-tender; testes normal; vitally stable, no distension. Determine the type of hernia, your reasoning and the plan. (new case) 442A

qs.q: What is the type of hernia, and what is your reasoning?
a: Right inguinal hernia (answer accepted: indirect) — it is above and medial to the pubic tubercle / above the inguinal ligament (femoral hernias are below and lateral), reducible, with a cough impulse and you cannot get above it.
qs.why: A reducible groin swelling with a cough impulse above the inguinal ligament (above and medial to the pubic tubercle), that you can't get above, is an inguinal hernia.

qs.q: What other types of groin hernia do you know?
qs.why: Groin hernias are indirect inguinal (commonest), direct inguinal and femoral.

qs.q: How do you differentiate between a direct and an indirect hernia?
a: Direct: medial to the inferior epigastric vessels (through Hesselbach's triangle). Indirect: lateral to them (through the deep ring).
qs.why: The inferior epigastric vessels mark the boundary: indirect hernias come through the deep ring lateral to them; direct hernias push through Hesselbach's triangle medial to them.

a: Elective hernia repair (mesh), open or laparoscopic.
qs.why: Hernias don't resolve and risk incarceration — elective mesh repair (open Lichtenstein or laparoscopic) is the standard.

qs.q: What are the indications for emergency repair? (reporter not sure this was asked)
a: Irreducibility with pain, strangulation (severe pain, tenderness, skin changes), bowel obstruction.
qs.why: An irreducible painful hernia, strangulation or bowel obstruction risks gangrenous bowel — emergency surgery.

tips.t: The doctor said do NOT say "herniotomy" — that is for children. Dr Hussam Al-Amri also asked for the name of the open procedure: Lichtenstein repair.

notes.t: Direct vs indirect cannot be decided reliably by examination; it is defined by the relation to the inferior epigastric vessels (confirmed at surgery).
